definitions.full: H5393. nishkah נִשְׁכָּה noun feminine chamber (rare || of לִשְׁכָּה , q. v.; compare W SG 67 ); — absolute ׳נ Neh 13:7 , suffix נִשְׁכָּתוֺ 3:30 , both rooms of individuals; plural absolute נְשָׁכוֺת 12:44 (Chronicles) = treasuries, storehouses.
